scope: Proposition 4.1 (Ancestor localization) of the manuscript “Virasoro Constraints under Projectivization” (preprints/Virasoro-Constraints-under-Projectivization-October-5-2026/virasoro-constraints-under-projectivization.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 065 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 573917aea43c708a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 11-12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are classes uF ∈ HF with coefficients of positive Novikov filtration, for F = B, X, and a symplectic power series R(z) ∈ End(Hfix)[[z]], with R − id of positive Novikov filtration, such that, writing Sf (z) = SF,tw(uF , z), Sbl(z) = M F=B,X Sf (z), one has SW (z) = R(z)Sbl(z), (4.1) AW (0) = c UR Y F=B,X AF,tw(uF ), (4.2) 11 where c is an invertible scalar independent of ancestor variables. For every curve coefficient, SW (z) is the expansion at infinity of a rational function of z. In (4.1) that rational function is expanded at z = 0; the equality is in Laurent series with a finite lower bound at each curve coefficient. Both R and its inverse admit quantized actions in the coefficientwise completion used here.
